Package fastkeyboard

Interface FastKeyboard

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
FastKeyboardImpl
public interface FastKeyboard extends AutoCloseable
Native Windows RawInput Keyboard API for Java. Provides access to hardware-level keystrokes and multiple keyboard devices.

    • open

      static FastKeyboard open()

    • openForWindow

      static FastKeyboard openForWindow(long targetWindowHandle)
      Creates a new FastKeyboard instance bound to a specific Win32 window (HWND). Keystrokes are only intercepted when the specified window has active focus.
      Parameters:
      targetWindowHandle - Native HWND of the target window.

    • startListening

      void startListening(FastKeyboardListener listener)

      Parameters:
      listener - The callback for keyboard events.

    • bindToWindow

      void bindToWindow(long targetWindowHandle)
      Binds input capture to a specific Win32 window handle. When bound, events are only dispatched if the window is currently in the foreground. Pass 0 to restore global capture.
      Parameters:
      targetWindowHandle - Native HWND
